ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous solid dark pigment field across both lobes; small, high-contrast white contiguous clusters are restricted to the extreme distal apices of the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrated boundary along the entire trailing edge; the right lobe exhibits a higher frequency of micro-peaks and valleys compared to the left lobe, which shows a more continuous but slightly undulating linear boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edges of both lobes, terminating in a sharp upward vertical sweep at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, roughly circular high-contrast white pixel clusters detected at the terminal tips of both lobes, consistent with localized scarring.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent jagged indentation (tissue loss) on the trailing edge of the right lobe; white pigment scarring localized on both fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Near-total saturation of dark pigment across the entire visible ventral surface area, presenting as a uniform low-intensity field.
